prompt:
Create a new production sprite atlas for the Mass Effect 1 fan RPG Relay Chronicles, matching the grounded, detailed, three-quarter painted cutout style of the supplied enemy and vehicle reference atlases. Exactly eight different isolated complete enemies, ONE full-body view per subject, arranged in a strictly regular 4-column by 2-row atlas on a truly transparent RGBA background. Landscape 1536 by 1024 if possible. Every subject completely inside its own cell, with generous fully transparent gutters of at least 24 pixels around every limb, barrel, antenna and projection. No touching, no overlaps, no cropping. No text, labels, grid lines, panels, scenery, floor, shadows, smoke, particles or glows outside the subject. Consistent upper-left soft lighting and three-quarter orientation facing slightly left. This is an illustrative prototype, not an official extracted game asset.

Top row left to right:
1. Geth recon drone from Mass Effect 1: compact hovering angular white-grey mechanical drone with a single luminous blue optical sensor, small integrated weapon and no humanoid legs; noticeably smaller and lighter than the next subject.
2. Geth assault drone from Mass Effect 1: heavier hovering grey angular shielded drone, a broad wedge-shaped chassis and visible integrated gun, single blue optic, clearly a flying machine with no humanoid feet; distinct wider silhouette from recon drone.
3. Geth rocket trooper from Mass Effect 1: slender synthetic biped with backward jointed legs, grey-white geth carapace, black tubing, narrow elongated hood with one blue optic; complete large shoulder-supported rocket launcher held ready, clearly distinguishable from ordinary rifle.
4. Geth shock trooper from Mass Effect 1: robust but still recognizably geth biped, pale white-grey layered chest and shoulder armor over black tendons, one blue head optic, rifle held across torso; heavier shoulder profile than rocket trooper.

Bottom row left to right:
5. Geth juggernaut from Mass Effect 1: very tall bulky red-plated geth heavy synthetic infantry, large rounded layered shoulders, broad chest, thick armored legs and heavy weapon across body, one blue optic; much broader than the shock trooper and not the exact destroyer already in the reference.
6. Geth stalker from Mass Effect 1: low agile spider-like geth synthetic with a compact hooded single blue optic, exposed black mechanical tendons, long articulated splayed limbs, crouched clinging-ready silhouette; no flight exhaust, no humanoid standing rifle pose.
7. Rachni worker from Mass Effect 1: small pale yellow-green insectoid organic worker, rounded swollen translucent green abdominal sacs, small low carapace and multiple thin pointed legs, chitin and organic skin; a clearly small non-humanoid creature, unlike tall armed rachni soldier. No hand-held weapon.
8. Automated security turret from Mass Effect 1: squat fixed grey industrial gun emplacement on a sturdy three-foot mount, angular armored housing, short heavy gun assembly, small blue optical sensor; no humanoid torso, no tank body, no wheels.

Keep all eight subjects equally easy to identify at small gameplay sprite scale; preserve meaningful relative widths and distinct shapes. Supply only the native transparent eight-body atlas. Do not reproduce background colors from the first reference.
